breaks: an alt text reading a visible expression as being AIMED at somebody ('grinning toward the audience') is accepted. The expression is in the frame; who it was meant for is not, so the description states as fact something the camera did not record (#1068). The perturbation is in blog_quality's shared matcher and the test it must break is the CAPTION one, which is what proves the caption path really goes through that matcher rather than a copy of it (#1224, L3)
